name: ai-impact
description: Scaling AI activity into business impact. Ten thinking tools your own AI agent runs with you against your real portfolio — some reflection, some working a number through until it fits your system, some diagnosis. They ask rather than answer, and each ends in one experiment to run.

plugins.name: ai-impact
plugins.description: Think through the questions that separate AI activity from AI impact, with your own agent and your own material: is this initiative really ready to commit to, has the constraint moved now that agents write the code, would flow metrics change any decision you make. Reflection, working-through and diagnosis — conversational, ending in an experiment rather than a score.
